providers.name: Claude
providers.note: In v1 the memo writers run on Claude. Sign in with your provider where the provider allows it, on the provider's own screen. Where it does not, you can paste a key as a last resort. It is encrypted, never visible to agents, and you can delete it in one click.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.note: Pasted key at launch. Sign-in is Next until approved by OpenAI.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.note: Pasted key. Runs the independent check alongside Claude in v1.

providers.note: Pasted key. Sign-in is Next until prototyped.
